intro: I am Executive Director of the Research and Statistics Department at the Czech National Bank. I lead the Bank's research and statistical functions, set their strategic priorities, and oversee the development of new analytical and forecasting tools.

My research focuses on monetary and macroprudential policy, banking and financial stability. I am particularly interested in how central bank policies affect credit and households, and how climate and geopolitical risks transmit through the financial system.
